blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Former President Rodrigo Duterte’s historic first appearance before an International Criminal Court (ICC) trial chamber has provided a much-needed morale boost to the thousands of victims of his bloody “war on drugs,” an independent fact-finding body said on Thursday. The non-government Truth Commission said Duterte’s presence at the international tribunal on Wednesday — his first since being arrested in March 2025—offers a tangible measure of hope that justice is proceeding on schedule in The Hague. But the pursuit of accountability extends beyond the international court, according to Truth Commission Chairman and former ICC Judge Raul Pangalangan. […]...
